verdicts.reason: A jams the headline against the top-left edge with no margin, puts the SOLSTICE wordmark under the headline, reverses the pill order, and runs the tagline as tiny inline text after the pills. It also drops most of the decorative circles and leaves a large dead gap in the middle, with the CTA pushed against the right edge. B keeps the decorative circles and has saner margins, but it repeats the brand-below-headline inversion and the reversed pills. Its tagline is wrapped into two illegibly small lines squeezed between the pills and an oversized CTA, so the CTA competes with the headline and the left third is mostly empty.
